heading: ABOUT ME
title: I'm an MCA student focused on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics. I like building things that actually work.
copy: My work spans predictive analytics, medical image verification, computer vision, and AI-powered recommendation systems — projects where I've had to move from research and papers into deployable, practical software. I've also worked as a Data Analyst Intern at Plan India, building automation scripts and Power BI dashboards, and I currently mentor students in Python and Data Analytics through Click at Career. Explaining technical concepts clearly to others has, in turn, made me better at reasoning through my own problems.
